title: Disconnected Preimages of Subsurfaces Under Finite Covers
statement: Given a finite cover $f:S_h\to S_g$ with $h>g\geq2$, is there always a four-holed sphere $H$ with essential boundary components in $S_g$ such that the interior of $f^{-1}(H)$ is disconnected, and what is the answer for a three-holed sphere?

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** The finite-cover preimage-disconnection question is posed as an unresolved problem, and no general theorem answering the four-holed or three-holed sphere versions was found.
